notes.title: Update 1.45
notes.notes:
Amazing week, we want to thank everyone for your support.
We have addressed the complaints about the introduction going away too quickly. Now you can control the speed and the text chunks are small for comfortable reading. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42562550/16c49d001e111dc9bbb3a34a591177a3748e2830.jpg

We also added our social media, the original short that started all of this, and the links to the Best Selling books if you feel inclined to some awesome reading.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42562550/47b10d66ef2a1598478899417037a454e180ab10.jpg

We apreciate your continuous feedback to improove the game!
